newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins Indonesia expansion contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins Indonesia expansion contract.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson said on Tuesday it had won an expansion contract with PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara in Indonesia for 50,000 lines Wireless in the Local Loop (WLL).
Pramindo, a joint venture involving PT Astra International and France Telecom, is the only fixed network operator in Sumatra and has a contract to install 516,000 lines all over Sumatra.

Ericsson said in a statement that with this additional contract its WLL solution, DRA 1900, has now been awarded contracts for more than 200,000 lines in Indonesia, making it the leading WLL solution in Indonesia.
